protocol.written: 2026-10-30, before any feature was extracted or any model was trained
protocol.corpus: Donate-a-Cry cleaned set, github.com/gveres/donateacry-corpus commit 6baf5ac, ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0
protocol.split: grouped by app install id (first 36 characters of the file name). Rarest class first, devices are ranked by sha256(seed + id) and go to test until at least a quarter of that class's clips are in test, skipping a device that would put more than half of the class in test. A device keeps the side it got first. Test is never read while choosing features or settings.
protocol.tuning: only on train, with cross validation grouped by device
protocol.audio: every clip goes through the Tapo camera channel (8 kHz G.711 A-law and back) before features, as at home
protocol.primary_metric: balanced accuracy on test (mean of per-class recall over the 5 classes). Chance and the always-hungry baseline are both 0.20
secondary_metrics: plain accuracy next to the always-hungry baseline
per-class recall and precision with counts
hungry vs not hungry ROC AUC
95% interval by bootstrap over test devices, 2000 resamples
protocol.decision_rule: The sound guess enters what the parent is told only if the lower end of the 95% interval of test balanced accuracy is above 0.20, and then only for the classes whose test precision is at least 0.5 with at least 3 test clips predicted. Otherwise the model still runs on every cry and its guess is logged as an event, and the parent hears the log-based reason alone.
